answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind an agent's historical proofs to a canonical lattice; each VRF sortition and VDF step exposes a minimal public transcript, so any cloned identity must rederive a unique ember of state, a crystal of timing, and an ivory chain of commitments. Since forging these transcripts requires solving discrete-log and polynomial-interpolation instances, the entropy gap makes Sybil cloning computationally infeasible.
